## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: R1–R9 under automated tests, skills no longer forge `runner: "aff"` for tdd/check, and close-batch refuses manifest `done` when verdict or recheck fails.

R1: orchestra check stamps runner orchestra
R2: suite record stamps runner orchestra
R3: close-batch accepts only runner orchestra
R4: close-batch refuses runner aff
R5: close-batch requires aff verdict for manifest claims
R6: close-batch requires aff recheck for manifest claims
R7: skills do not instruct runner aff for tdd/check
R8: close-batch does not import affidavit
R9: assertion-level red via Affidavit CLI only

## Approach

Run the phase's focused pytest modules and the skill runner-stamp scanner through the real entry points (`python3 -m pytest` on the named tests; close-batch behavior covered by close_batch tests). Do not run the unfiltered full suite.
